comment: Every MSM module's right-click menu carries the same cosmetic Theme pair, Classic (default) and Night Mode, set from a MenuLabel and two MenuItems in each widget's appendContextMenu. It changes only which panel SVG is drawn, so it is deliberately left out of the entries. Two modules keep a Theme line: BlankPanel, where the theme is the whole of what the module does, and TreasureVCO, whose Theme menu adds two choices of its own, Espen's Treasure | Jedi and Omri's Treasure | Mushroom. CrazyMult's Type item changes what the module computes and is not cosmetic, so it keeps its line. The plugin has no knob, port or display menus and no panel gestures: every appendContextMenu is on a ModuleWidget, and src/ contains no onButton, onDoubleClick or createContextMenu override.
